Summary: Requisition accepted with zero quantity or unknown item
Description:
Related requirement: FR-001
Steps to reproduce: Shelter Coordinator submits a requisition with quantity 0 (or item "pizza").
Expected: System rejects it and shows a validation error.
Actual: The requisition is saved and appears in the dispatch queue.

Summary: Same warehouse stock allocated to two requisitions
Description:
Related requirement: FR-002
Steps to reproduce: Create two requisitions for 80 water with only 100 in stock; two managers click Allocate at the same time.
Expected: The second requisition receives only the remaining 20 and stock never goes below zero.
Actual: Both receive 80 and warehouse stock goes negative.

Summary: Unqualified volunteer appears in dispatch list
Description:
Related requirement: FR-003
Steps to reproduce: Create a task needing first aid and driving; one registered volunteer has only driving (another is unverified).
Expected: Only verified, available volunteers with both skills are listed.
Actual: The driving-only and the unverified volunteers are also listed.

Summary: Delivery can be marked Delivered before it leaves the warehouse
Description:
Related requirement: FR-004
Steps to reproduce: Open a delivery in status Loaded and change it straight to Delivered.
Expected: System rejects the change (Loaded can only go to In Transit).
Actual: Status becomes Delivered and the requisition closes.

Summary: Situation report totals include cancelled requisitions
Description:
Related requirement: FR-005
Steps to reproduce: Generate a report for a period that contains cancelled requisitions.
Expected: Cancelled requisitions are excluded from needs and totals.
Actual: Report includes them and inflates unmet-need totals.

Summary: Dashboard shows a blank map when the device is offline
Description:
Related requirement: NFR-001
Steps to reproduce: Load the dashboard online, switch to airplane mode, reload the page.
Expected: Cached map tiles and last-synced shelter data are shown with an "Offline" banner.
Actual: Blank map and a network error are shown.

Summary: Relief Volunteer can run supply allocation
Description:
Related requirement: NFR-002
Steps to reproduce: Log in as a Relief Volunteer and call POST /api/allocations/run.
Expected: System returns 403 Forbidden; only a Disaster Manager may allocate.
Actual: Request succeeds and warehouse stock changes.
